tier_caveat: Worker API equivalent of configured chatgpt/gpt-6-luna; no subscription transport. Utility is a pinned experimental tier, not the automatic utility resolver.

preflight.planning_caveat: Unmeasured bytes/4 input heuristic, full output limits, no cache discount; not a billing estimate or spending guard.
preflight.note: Best-effort stop, not a provider dollar cap. Jev has no dispatch dollar ceiling. Byte/token bound assumes at most one input token per decoded UTF-8 byte plus framing allowance; no cache discount. In-flight billing can exceed reserve.
